A fast-paced endless runner where the player controls a neon ship moving through a scrolling tunnel. Tap/click to switch lanes and avoid randomly generated obstacles. The game ends (loss) when the ship collides with an obstacle or falls off the track.

1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.

4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');

8:

10:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400;
11:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
12: 
13:   const LANE_COUNT = 3;
14:   const LANE_WIDTH = canvas.width / LANE_COUNT;
15:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 30;
16:   const OBSTACLE_SIZE = 30;
17:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED = 3;
18:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
19: 
20:   let playerLane = 1; // start in middle lane (0‑based)
21:   let obstacles = [];
22:   let lastSpawn = 0;
23:   let gameOver = false;
24: 
25:   // Input: click/tap to move right, wrap around
26:   // Audio setup
27:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
28:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
29:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
30:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
31:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
32:     osc.type = 'sine';
33:     osc.connect(gain);
34:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
35:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
36:     osc.start();
37:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur / 1000);
38:   }
39: 
40:   // Input handling with sound
41:   canvas.addEventListener('click', async () => {
42:     // resume audio context (required on first interaction)
43:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') await audioCtx.resume();
44:     // lane change sound
45:     playTone(440, 100);
46:     if (gameOver) return;
47:     playerLane = (playerLane + 1) % LANE_COUNT;
48:   });
49:     if (gameOver) return;
50:     playerLane = (playerLane + 1) % LANE_COUNT;
51:   });
52: 
53:   function spawnObstacle() {
54:     const lane = Math.floor(Math.random() * LANE_COUNT);
55:     obstacles.push({ lane, y: -OBSTACLE_SIZE });
56:   }
57: 
58:   function update(delta) {
59:     // spawn obstacles
60:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
61:       spawnObstacle();
62:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
63:     }
64:     // move obstacles
65:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.y += OBSTACLE_SPEED);
66:     // remove off‑screen
67:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.y < canvas.height + OBSTACLE_SIZE);
68:     // collision detection
69:     for (const o of obstacles) {
70:       if (o.lane === playerLane && o.y + OBSTACLE_SIZE > canvas.height - PLAYER_SIZE && o.y < canvas.height) {
71:         playTone(200, 300);
72:         gameOver = true;
73:         break;
74:       }
75:     }
76:   }
77: 
78:   function draw() {
79:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
80:     // draw background gradient and stars
81:     const bgGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
82:     bgGradient.addColorStop(0, '#001');
83:     bgGradient.addColorStop(1, '#004');
84:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGradient;
85:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
86: 
87:     // stars for a simple space effect
88:     if (!window.__stars) {
89:       window.__stars = [];
90:       for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
91:         window.__stars.push({ x: Math.random() * canvas.width, y: Math.random() * canvas.height, r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
92:       }
93:     }
94:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
95:     for (const s of window.__stars) {
96:       ctx.beginPath();
97:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
98:       ctx.fill();

102: 
103:     // draw lanes (optional visual aid)
104:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#222';
105:     for (let i = 1; i < LANE_COUNT; i++) {
106:       ctx.beginPath();
107:       ctx.moveTo(i * LANE_WIDTH, 0);
108:       ctx.lineTo(i * LANE_WIDTH, canvas.height);
109:       ctx.stroke();
110:     }
111:     // draw player
112:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff'; // neon cyan
113:     const playerX = playerLane * LANE_WIDTH + (LANE_WIDTH - PLAYER_SIZE) / 2;
114:     const playerY = canvas.height - PLAYER_SIZE - 10;
115:     ctx.fillRect(playerX, playerY, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE);
116:     // draw obstacles

118:     for (const o of obstacles) {
119:       const ox = o.lane * LANE_WIDTH + (LANE_WIDTH - OBSTACLE_SIZE) / 2;
120:       ctx.fillRect(ox, o.y, OBSTACLE_SIZE, OBSTACLE_SIZE);
121:     }
122:     // game over overlay
123:     if (gameOver) {
124:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
125:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
126:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
127:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
128:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
129:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
130:     }
131:   }

133:   let lastTime = 0;
134:   function loop(time) {
135:     const delta = time - lastTime;
136:     lastTime = time;
137:     if (!gameOver) update(delta);
138:     draw();
139:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);

142:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
